trial_court: Family Court, Belonia, South Tripura, Case No. T.S. (Divorce) 130/2021
case_name: Anup Data vs Smt. Priyanka Bhowmik
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in 2005. Respondent-wife filed an application for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 alleging cruelty by the appellant-husband. Appellant contested the proceedings and the trial court decreed the suit by dissolving the marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: It is evident that the relationship between the parties has irretrievably broken down, with no scope of reconciliation.

legal_principles.principle: A subsequent marriage solemnized in violation of Section 15 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is void.
legal_principles.held: He submits that the second marriage of the respondent is in violation of Section 15 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, and therefore void.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed, and the judgment and decree passed by the trial court are set aside. The parties' marriage is restored.
